description: This source file defines the class ImmutableAdaptableBuilder, which implements the AdaptableBuilder interface to build instances of ImmutableAdaptable. The class manages properties like topicPath, payload, and headers, providing methods to set payload and headers, and a build method to create an ImmutableAdaptable object.

classes.name: ImmutableAdaptableBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating ImmutableAdaptable instances, designed to be thread-safe and immutable after build.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ImmutableAdaptableBuilder with a specific TopicPath.

methods.name: withPayload
methods.description: Sets the payload for the builder.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Sets the headers for the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an ImmutableAdaptable instance using the accumulated properties.
